title: ‘Helmet Saved His Life’: Dylan van Baarle Injured in Car Collision Ahead of Wedding to Ferrand-Prévot
content:
Pauline Ferrand-Prévot describes a frightening training crash that left Dylan van Baarle needing wrist surgery ahead of their wedding.

Read the full article at ‘Helmet Saved His Life’: Dylan van Baarle Injured in Car Collision Ahead of Wedding to Ferrand-Prévot on Velo.
